title: Isoperimetric partitions: standard and non-standard
description:
Slides of the talk given on 9 February 2026 at the conference XXXV Convegno Nazionale di Calcolo delle Variazioni (Riccione, Italy, 9-13 February 2026).

The slides are an HTML presentation built with reveal.js: unzip the archive and open index.html in a web browser. All dependencies are bundled, so no internet connection is needed.

Online version: https://paolini.github.io/2026-talk-Riccione/
